content:
This character card has no dedicated location content - you must decide whether its scenario/opening message implies any concrete place worth modeling as a location, and if so, synthesize a minimal set of locations for it. Return a single SynthesizedLocations JSON object only. Do not include explanations, markdown, or extra keys.

Fields:
- locations: a list of at most 2 locations, each with:
  - name: a short, concrete name for the place (e.g. "Example Bedroom", not "a room").
  - description: a self-contained description of the location - what it looks like, its atmosphere - written as our own prose, inferred from the scenario/opening but not copied verbatim.

Local-model rules:
- An empty locations list is the correct answer when the scenario and opening message give no real, concrete location cue - do not fabricate a generic setting just to fill the field.
- Never output more than 2 locations - pick only the ones actually implied, most important first.
- Prefer a single well-grounded location over two weakly-inferred ones.
